items.source:
This is an artificial arrangement of 16 unicode characters,
with its sole purpose being to never match user-declared values.
items.translation: 这是由 16 个 Unicode 字符组成的虚构排列，其唯一目的是确保永远不会匹配用户声明的值。

items.source: Constant defining a value for no default - as a replacement for null which we cannot use in annotation attributes.
items.translation: 定义无默认值值的常量——作为无法在注解属性中使用的 `null` 的替代方案。

items.source: Common value constants shared between bind annotations.
items.translation: 绑定注解之间共享的公共值常量。
